scientific.integrity: The exact two-state QHM matrix is reconstructed from the defining update. The stability interval follows from the quadratic Jury criterion; the scalar rate optimum follows from exact discriminant roots, a root-product lower bound, and radius-scaled Jury inequalities. Nilpotence is verified from vanishing trace and determinant.
limitations: The theorem is for one deterministic positive quadratic curvature mode.
It optimizes asymptotic spectral radius, not transient norm growth or multimode minimax performance.
The deadbeat step requires exact scalar curvature knowledge.
Stochastic gradients, schedules, and QHAdam are outside scope.

title: Exact scalar rate optimum and unique deadbeat slice of QHM
